ns2:section.sectionText: Students enrolling in MACS 499 need to be in their second-to-last or final semester in the MACS major. Students will need to develop a portfolio of their MACS coursework up to this point. For more information on portfolio requirements, please download the "Media & Cinema Studies - Senior Portfolio" document on Media's Forms & Petitions website: https://media.illinois.edu/student-resources/forms-petitions
